A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, Visual Implicit Autoregressive Modeling, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–H. Pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered images; the first-page differences are limited to author information, version metadata and spacing.

before.justification: v1 reports original VIAR image-generation, efficiency, convergence and editing results in Section 4, with additional architecture comparisons and computational measurements in Appendices D–H.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original empirical results, including ImageNet generation scores, memory and throughput measurements, ablations and qualitative editing examples.

M1.justification: Section 3, Algorithms 1–2 and Appendices A–C retain identical architecture, S-JFB training, fusion projection, iteration schedules and KV-cache procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet 256 × 256 generation coverage and zero-shot inpainting and class-conditional editing scenarios. No dataset, task or evaluated population is added or removed.

E2.justification: The VAR comparators in Tables 1, 3 and 5 and Figure 8 are unchanged. Table 4 retains L-DiT-7B, VQGAN, ViTVQ and RQ-Transformer, including the same rejection-sampling variants.

E3.justification: The 50,000-sample ImageNet evaluation, metrics, CFG settings, iteration schedules, model configurations and hardware-based testing procedures remain identical in Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The convergence analysis in Figure 3, schedule comparisons in Table 2, architecture analysis in Appendix D and qualitative editing cases in Figure 7 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting, without reported repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-estimation procedure is introduced.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results, including appendix results, are identical. For example, Table 1 retains VIAR FID 2.16 and sFID 8.07 at CFG 1.5, while Table 3 retains 32.08 images/s and 8.53 GB for VIARs4.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, fixed-point formulation, gradient approximation, complexity reasoning and compute-budget equations in Section 3 and Appendix B are identical. No theorem, proof or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about integrating implicit equilibrium layers into VAR, reducing parameters and memory, enabling flexible inference compute and preserving generation and editing quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations of convergence, compute allocation, parameter efficiency and editing quality are unchanged. Appendix G retains the qualification that VAR's total training time is an estimated lower bound.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures in Section 4.1 and Appendices A–C and G are unchanged. Both abstracts provide the same code-and-model repository link.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography, related-work discussion and novelty positioning are identical, including Appendix F's discussion of complementarity with FastVAR and ScaleKV.

P1.justification: v2 adds equal-contribution credit for Pengfei Jiang and Jixiang Luo and revises affiliations to include Xiamen University. The version/date stamp changes; scientific prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised author line and expanded affiliation footnote cause small first-page spacing shifts in the abstract and introduction. All figures and tables retain identical content and placement, and pages 2–14 render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies contribution credit and affiliations, with minor first-page layout adjustments. The scientific exposition, evidence, reproducibility information and appendices are unchanged, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
